title: HMS Blonde orange sphere rises from the ocean
place_text: near the Cook Islands, South Pacific

tellings.quote: and he writes in his diary at 3:30 a.m. on August uh 12th, 1825. This is 200 years ago. He said the Night Watch reported this orange spherical object rise from the ocean uh at 7°.

plain: In 1825, aboard the British ship HMS Blonde near the Cook Islands in the South Pacific, the night watch is said to have seen an orange sphere rise out of the ocean. The UFO historian Richard Dolan tells Michels this from the diary of a man aboard named Andrew Bloxom, which by Dolan's reading records at 3:30 a.m. on 12 August 1825 that "the Night Watch reported this orange spherical object rise from the ocean" at seven degrees. Dolan offers it as evidence that such sightings are about 200 years old.
